intro: Tok'Kar and the soldiers on the coast are stationed to guard Stonard against murlocs, or to send warning when the force is too large. Tok'Kar wants six sawtooth snapper claws and offers one of the outpost's weapons in thanks.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the threat of murlocs along the coast, we're stationed out here to protect--or warn if the force is too large--of any coming threats to Stonard. It doesn't give us much time for relaxation, and we could use some more help if you're able.

The sawtooth snappers' claws make for fine weapons when properly prepared. Bring me some of their claws and I'll see you're rewarded with one of our weapons in thanks for the fresh meat and the good company.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Good mead, a warm fire, an army of orcs and an arsenal of weapons... That's all we really need out here along the coast. I don't regret my position out here safeguarding Stonard, but it would be nice if we could one day get a burrow, or at least a tower.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Glad to see you're alive and well, friend.
These claws should make do nicely. The more weapons we have at the ready for attacks against us, the better off we'll be.
I'll get started on your weapon as soon as possible. It will only take a short time. I've become quite adept and quick at their production.
